[[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] '''Temereth''' held the title of the Third Keeper of Antiquties in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Korriban Sith Academy]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] wrote a report to the [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] who recovered ancient tablets from the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orbis Keln]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=message|The Ruined City Tablets|Overseer Temereth}}</ref>
